createChild.title: Create a child account
createChild.hint: Open an account that signs in with a username and password for a child who has no email. You manage the account; only you can change its password.
createChild.usernameHint: 4-30 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot (.) and underscore (_). Example: ali.kaya
createChild.pwHint: At least 8 characters with at least one letter and one digit. Must not contain the username.
createChild.schoolHint: The school membership stays pending until a teacher of the school or an admin approves it.
createChild.consent: I have read the {{brand}} privacy notice and, as the parent, consent to my child's personal data being processed to provide the service.
createChild.usernameInvalid: The username must be 4-30 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dots and underscores only.
createChild.pwInvalid: The password must be at least 8 characters with at least one letter and one digit.
createChild.pwContainsUsername: The password must not contain the username.
createChild.consentRequired: Please confirm the parental consent to continue.
createChild.createError: The child account could not be created.
createChild.limitNote: You can create at most {{max}} child accounts.
createChild.summaryText: The account for {{name}} was created. Your child signs in with this username:
createChild.summaryLogin: On the sign-in page they type this username into the "Email or username" field and the password you chose into the password field.
createChild.summaryPwNote: For security the password is not shown again. If it is forgotten you can reset it here.

resetPw.title: New password for {{name}}
resetPw.hint: Choose the new password yourself and share it with your child. Your child's open sessions are signed out.
resetPw.done: Password changed. Your child can sign in with the new password.
resetPw.error: The password could not be changed.
